title: Privacy rules went further than the law; bring every rule, check and page copy back to the legal line
problem: The usage rules banned cookies outright, made counting opt-in, forbade storing even the kind of referring site, and banned any analytics vendor. The law (GDPR, ePrivacy/PECR, CCPA) requires none of that for functional cookies or anonymous aggregate counts. The extra restrictions cost the portfolio its measurement: live_url_visitors is null on every reading, and distribution (the stated limiter) cannot be judged without knowing where visitors come from. The owner, 2026-10-20: 'follow laws but going beyond them is too much.'
evidence: portfolio/usage/README.md rule 1 before 2026-10-20: 'No accounts, no cookies, no IP storage, no device fingerprints, no cross-site identifiers, no content.'
platform/counter/counter.mjs before 2026-10-20: 'no referrer' stored, so no reading could say which kind of site sends visitors.
portfolio/usage/validate_usage.py FORBIDDEN_SIGNAL_TOKENS included 'cookie', so even a count named like cookie_banner_dismissed failed validation.
change: Done in the first PR: owner direction recorded in prompts/goals.md; usage README rules, PRODUCT_PLAYBOOK privacy and usage sections, AGENTS.md and DIRECTION.md rewritten to 'follow the law, no stricter'; 'cookie' dropped from the validator's forbidden tokens; the counter records the referring-site class (src:<class>, closed list, reduced in the browser, so no host is sent) with tests and matching site copy. Remainder split out: counter deployment needs an owner-provided always-on HTTPS host (P046); the shared consent helper waits for a product that needs an identifier (build it with that product).
metric: readings in portfolio/usage/site-visits.json with page_loads > 0 and at least one src:<class> key
baseline: 0: site-visits.json does not exist yet and platform/counter/site.json has an empty url (2026-10-20)
result: No change yet: portfolio/usage/site-visits.json still does not exist (checked 2026-10-23); the rules, validator, counter code and copy are at the legal line, but no reading can exist until the owner deploys platform/counter (P046). Not a failure of the change; the metric waits on P046.

history.note: Part 3 swept: grep 'never people|no analytics vendor|no cookies' finds only descriptions that are still true (the site has no cookies or vendor) and the validator test for person-shaped signals (email-like keys), which the law still supports; nothing blocks a legal feature. Remaining: (1) deploy platform/counter (owner host) and (2) the shared consent helper, which should wait for a product that needs an identifier.
Closed: rules, validator, counter code and copy are at the legal line. The only open piece (deploy) is owner-gated and is now P046, so the agent queue is not shown as in progress.
